glottolog.classification_source: official Glottolog 5.3 tree_glottolog_newick.txt; generated from glottolog/glottolog release data
glottolog.metadata_source: Glottolog-CLDF 5.3 languages.csv supplied with the resumed study; used only for metadata, language-level normalization, and pseudo-category diagnostics

methodology.isolates: each top-level isolate is one independent genealogical unit
methodology.macroarea_role: secondary descriptive metadata only; never used for weighting or assignment
methodology.family_assignment: map each source Glottocode to the root of its one-line tree in the official Glottolog 5.3 Newick forest
methodology.distinct_language_normalization: language-level Glottocodes count as themselves; dialect Glottocodes count by their Glottolog Language_ID; family-level source Glottocodes remain source records but are not guessed into a language
methodology.pseudo_category_rule: top-level CLDF family rows absent from the official genealogical Newick forest are kept separate and never treated as independent spoken-language families
